svg.title: exhibition_arena schematic
svg.text: exhibition_arena · National Gate Skills Exhibition, Seoul World Cup Stadium (ch47 hook, ch49–61)
Schematic plan in metres (pitch to scale, stands simplified), local frame: page-up is the opposite stand, NOT north. Seoul World Cup Stadium is a real venue in Seongsan-dong, Mapo-gu;
the exhibition and every installation drawn here are fictional (venue decided here; beats ch58: "the stadium erupts"). Layout follows scripts/ch052 and ch056. Alias exhibition_stadium.
1 The course: grey padded modular floor on a protective deck over the pitch, 36
× 60 m; modules are reset between rounds (timed event ch50–51, adaptive bracket
2 Semifinal set (ch56): two parallel identical lanes, each with a pivot bridge,
a pendulum and a weighted exit shutter. Competitors run AWAY from the operator
3 The LEFT WALL: the runner's-left wall of Taeo's lane in the final (ch57 hook:
"NIB. LEFT WALL. TAKE THE HIT."; ch58).
4 Far targets at the end of each lane: Sera's shot rides the release (ch58).
5 Near clear safety barrier; the operator boxes are raised glass booths behind
it, one per lane. Taeo sits in one while his crew runs (ch51 BangBang's clip;
6 Service exit behind the boxes into the under-stand corridor: cream concrete,
fluorescent strips, equipment trestle, wide service doors, queue barrier;
daylight from the open loading door at the far end (ch52, ch56).
7 Crew staging on the track: benches, Haein's tech table, Sejin's med kit.
8 Draw stage: small arena-side platform, broad access ramp for Orrin, blank
bracket board at the rear, officials' desk at stage right (ch56 final draw; also
the ch49 draw and the ch53 bracket).
9 Archery range at end A: Sera's solo showcase (ch49 deal, ch55).
10 Sunline's aerial record rig at end B (ch50 prep, ch55 record).
11 Stage and big screen at end B: award ceremony, the mic (ch59–61), the
12 Press pit in front of the stage under the lighting-rig truss: the rig drops
13 VIP enclosure high in the opposite stand: Baek watches (ch54 hook, ch56).
14 BangBang's fan block, opposite stand: the chant (ch57, ch59–60).
51/58: behind Taeo in the operator box, through the glass, up the lanes. 57:
from the course toward the chanting block. 58: high wide over the final. 60:
from the stage side as the rig falls toward the pit.
• The course is always seen from outside by Taeo: he never runs it ("his summons
• Real venue, fictional event: no real sponsor, team or stadium signage; every
screen, pass and board is a blank shape for the letterer.
